cs.t: I bought an HP Victus, mostly because I came across a great deal and it has GeForce RTX 3070 graphics. I'm running Pop! OS linux and it worked out of the box, no special setup necessary. So far I'm happy with it and starting to ask myself why I didn't do this earlier. :)
cs.th: Ask HN: Is there a developer laptop that does not suck and is not a Mac in 2022?

cs.t: I bought an HP Victus 16", AMD CPU, 32GB RAM Ultimately the deciding factor was the price and the GeForce RTX 3070 GPU, it was on sale, and Linux drivers were available for all of the hardware. I'm running Pop! OS and haven't had any issues.
